title: ValidatedPath.depth is misleading for single-cert chains
description: In pkix-path/src/lib.rs line 1494, depth is computed as chain.len().saturating_sub(1). For a 1-cert chain (just the leaf, anchored directly), depth = 0. This is technically correct (zero intermediates), but the field name 'depth' and the pub doc do not specify whether it counts intermediates or total chain length. A caller wanting 'how many certs are in the validated chain' would need depth + 1. What goes wrong: ambiguity for callers who interpret depth as chain length rather than intermediate count. The ValidatedPath struct is published and serde-serializable (AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6), so the semantic of this field fossilizes. Recommend: clarify the rustdoc to explicitly state 'number of intermediate certificates between the leaf and the trust anchor; 0 when the leaf is issued directly by the anchor.' Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-path/src/lib.rs, ValidatedPath struct definition.
